newsitem.title: USA: Willingboro, N.J., funding vote delayed -- paper.
newsitem.headline: Willingboro, N.J., funding vote delayed -- paper.

text.p: The New Jersey Assembly's Appropriations Committee delayed until next week a bill to restore $1.8 million in funding to the Willingboro school district, the Philadelphia Inquirer reported Tuesday.
The move was required because of a technical error in the bill.

The bill would restore some of the money the district lost under Gov. Christine Whitman's new school financing formula. Willingboro, which recently approved a tentative $50.9 million budget for next year, was one of 20 districts that lost money under the new state formula.
The Whitman school spending plan is the subject of a lawsuit in state Supreme Court. Opening arguments in the case begin Tuesday.
